invariants.rationale: Since textY starts as getHeight() and can only decrease by up to background.getTopHeight(), result cannot exceed getHeight().
If background is null, textY (result) is never decremented: it is either getHeight() or possibly cast to (int)getHeight() if font.usesIntegerPositions().

invariants.expression: background == null || result == getHeight() - background.getTopHeight() || result == (int)(getHeight() - background.getTopHeight())
invariants.rationale: If background is not null, then result is either the float or integer version of (getHeight() - background.getTopHeight()), depending on font.usesIntegerPositions().
The code always dereferences font, so font must be non-null.
If font.usesIntegerPositions() is true, result was cast to int and so is integral; otherwise it may be any float.
